rows.name: authorizeObservation
rows.rationale: Production decides consent per (project, repository) pair in decideRepositoryConsent, whose pair predicate and record-subject-mismatch refusal feed computeCoverage; the conformance file's own sweep already runs through computeCoverage. authorizeObservation is a parallel per-pair predicate over the older ConsentResolution that no production module calls [Inferred: superseded by the consent-decision pipeline].

clause.heading: ### Requirement: CAP1-REQ-016 — No source is inspected through authority the project did not grant
clause.quote: Syzygy SHALL NOT observe any repository or source without a recorded in-force consent record for the exact (observing project, repository) pair. Consent granted to one project SHALL NOT admit observation by another. No served content, structure, or derived fact SHALL originate from an unconsented source.

anchors.role: refusal when the record's pair is not the entry's pair
daemon decides before any content read

rows.name: deriveEffectiveStatus
rows.rationale: The only producer of AuthorityExposure. The human route has an optional getAuthorityExposures dependency that the production composition never supplies, so the page renders the disclosed absence and the machine channel carries no authority exposure.

clause.heading: ### Requirement: CAP1-REQ-046 — Owning authority and effective status are exposed, stamp and record readable apart
clause.quote: For every answer resting on a governance artifact, Syzygy SHALL expose the artifact's owning authority and governing revision, and SHALL distinguish the artifact's self-declared lifecycle stamp (untrusted content) from its effective status (derived from the owner-act record). Where they disagree, the effective status governs and the disagreement renders as a disclosed fact. An artifact with no owner-act record renders effectively unadopted whatever its stamp claims.

anchors.role: production composition passes no authority source

rows.name: artifactInForce
rows.rationale: Consumes an AuthorityExposure, which nothing in production produces (see deriveEffectiveStatus).

rows.name: isComplete
rows.rationale: The requirement (a partial capture never renders as whole) is carried per repository by computeCoverage's degraded-partial state and by coverageBoundary's declared captured scopes, both served on both channels. No production code asserts a project-level 'complete', so the aggregate predicate has no caller; the daemon adapters also mint only full captures, so the partial arm is unreachable at runtime today.

clause.heading: ### Requirement: CAP1-REQ-014 — Incomplete coverage is never rendered as complete coverage
clause.quote: Syzygy SHALL NOT present a partial capture as full scope. WHEN a snapshot is partial, the captured scope SHALL be declared explicitly, the uncaptured portion SHALL render `Unknown`, and no aggregate over the full scope SHALL render as if whole.

anchors.role: human channel renders the partial state

rows.name: proposeEntryLink
rows.rationale: REQ-053 says Syzygy MAY draft the proposal and SHALL NOT write or render it as applied. The prohibition limbs are carried in production by the proposed/current rendering (renderState over a constant empty proposal list) and by the absence of any governed write (state-dir refusal in main.ts). The optional drafting limb has no production caller; supplying one is a feature the u2a.7 non-goals exclude, not an unwired mandate.

clause.heading: ### Requirement: CAP1-REQ-053 — Syzygy may propose the link; it never writes it, and a proposal never renders as applied
clause.quote: Syzygy MAY draft a proposed repository-entry link as a Proposal (RFC1-27). Syzygy SHALL NOT directly write the root README or any other location outside its two writable namespaces, and a proposed link SHALL never be rendered, counted, or served as an applied change: the finding stays computed from the actual front door, and the proposal renders as proposed material, visually and machine-readably distinct, with no status authority.

anchors.role: production proposals are the empty list
no write path into the governed plane

rows.name: extractDiscoverabilityDistinctions
rows.rationale: The machine channel passes empty lists for the authority and discoverability planes to the distinction sweep, which then lists those kinds as missing. REQ-064 names the four-value discoverability domain as a distinction that must be machine-readable; today it is honestly reported missing, not carried.

clause.heading: ### Requirement: CAP1-REQ-064 — Every distinction is machine-readable and recoverable without vision
clause.quote: Every distinction Capability 1 draws — epistemic label, tier, Unknown reason, freshness, consent state, adopted versus unadopted, proposed versus current, effective status versus stamp, the four-value discoverability domain — SHALL be carried as a machine-readable attribute on the rendered unit and SHALL be recoverable without colour, position, or layout, by label, text, or structure. Accessibility of the behavior is required; no UI framework is specified.

rows.name: epistemicMarking
rows.rationale: The marking is the fact's own label as text. Production emits it as the epistemic-label distinction on every fact (extractDistinctions, machine channel) and as data-epistemic-label on the human channel; epistemicMarking is a one-line restatement with no caller.

clause.heading: ### Requirement: CAP1-REQ-045 — Inferred is distinguishable from observed; generated presentation is never the source
clause.quote: Every fact Capability 1 serves SHALL carry its epistemic label (Observed / Inferred / Unknown) verbatim, and inferred information SHALL be distinguishable from observed information in every rendering, machine-readably and without relying on colour, position, or layout. Generated presentation artifacts SHALL never be the source of any answer: every answer's cited basis is its owning authority, never a rendering of it.

anchors.role: label distinction built from the fact
emitted per fact on the machine channel
label rendered as text on the human channel

rows.name: citeBasis
rows.rationale: The prohibition limb (a presentation artifact is never a cited basis) holds structurally: production states a basis only as constituent fact names and never builds a BasisCandidate. The positive limb (the owning authority is the cited basis) has no production source because ExplanationFactSet.owningAuthority is populated by nothing in the daemon; that is the authority-exposure gap u2a.13 owns.

clause.heading: ### Requirement: CAP1-REQ-045 — Inferred is distinguishable from observed; generated presentation is never the source

rows.name: queryKey
rows.rationale: Production computes one evaluation at start-up and serves every request from that same object, stamped with evaluationId, so two equivalent queries cannot diverge and every answer names its evaluation. queryKey/answersAgree are the test-side comparison of two independent runs and have no production caller.

clause.heading: ### Requirement: CAP1-REQ-042 — Equivalent queries at one revision expose equivalent facts
clause.quote: Two equivalent queries — same selection, same evaluation identity, same declared filters, same scenario context — SHALL expose equivalent facts in the deterministic layer, and every answer SHALL name the evaluation identity it was computed at. An answer that cannot name its evaluation is not an answer.

rows.name: answersAgree
rows.rationale: Same as queryKey: equality of two runs is judged in tests; production serves one stamped evaluation.

clause.heading: ### Requirement: CAP1-REQ-060 — Identities are the accepted, stable, literal ones
clause.quote: Capability 1 SHALL identify projects and repositories by their declared opaque identifiers: a display name is a label, never an identity; renaming changes the label and no identifier; a repository's identity is never a URL, path, or branch. No implementation-specific identifier is introduced as a project or repository identity in any served answer.

rows.name: isLocatorShaped
rows.rationale: REQ-060: a repository's identity is never a URL, path or branch; a served identity equal to a URL or path is its falsifier. The declaration reader accepts any non-empty string as project.id and repositories[].id and no production module calls the shape check. Runtime probe (probe-req060.test.ts.txt; output in evidence.json): a declaration with project id 'https://example.com/acme/project' and repository id '/srv/repos/shared' reads, registers and is served as facts.projectId verbatim.

rows.name: renderSuperseded
rows.rationale: No production code produces a superseded observation or assesses currency: assessCurrency has no non-test caller either (syzygy-dov.2 is the planning bead for it), and the daemon keeps no earlier evaluation to supersede. The limb is vacuous today rather than violated [Inferred]; it becomes live when retention or last-good state is authorized.

clause.heading: ### Requirement: CAP1-REQ-062 — Stale evidence cannot silently remain current or favourable
clause.quote: Evidence past its declared currency bound at the evaluation's as-of instant SHALL NOT support a current or favourable answer: the dependent claim renders `Unknown` with reason `stale-beyond-currency-bound`, and a claim class with no declared currency bound renders `Unknown` with reason `no-currency-bound-declared`. Staleness of superseded observations is visible on the primary surface. A displayed answer changes only through a new identified evaluation — never by the wall clock silently.

anchors.role: machine channel only forwards states it is given

rows.name: authorizeWrite
rows.rationale: Capability 1 performs no governed write; the production boundary is the start-up refusal of a state directory inside either real governed root, and the write-universe oracle is the external effect observer in cap1-system. authorizeWrite is already exported only from @syzygy/cap1-core/testing and compares by raw startsWith (it permits 'openspec/../README.md'); the conformance file pins only green prefix cases.

clause.heading: ### Requirement: CAP1-REQ-061 — Capability 1 observes and presents; its write boundary is the governed plane
clause.quote: Capability 1's behavior SHALL cause no mutation beyond governed proposals and Syzygy-owned presentation or specification artifacts inside `openspec/**` and `.syzygy/**` where accepted authority permits them. No source-code edit, root-README edit, deployment, scheduler mutation, or other external effect is part of this capability, and no manifest field may widen that write universe: a field purporting to do so is inoperative and renders as a contradiction routed to the owner.
